merge_from_message: merge the contents of one protobuf message into another using MergeFrom
copy_from_message: copy the contents of one protobuf message into another using CopyFrom
parse_from_string: parse serialized protobuf binary data into a message using ParseFromString
serialize_to_string: serialize a protobuf message to a binary string using SerializeToString
list_fields_message: list all non-empty fields of a protobuf message using ListFields
